Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner first mis-mapped the evidence by concluding that petrified palm trees support “There was once more water in the area” (A). Palm fossils primarily indicate a previously warmer climate, not specifically greater water availability. By focusing on humidity/rainfall rather than temperature as the limiting factor—and since “warmer climate” isn’t an option—the Planner unjustifiably chose A, leading to the wrong solution.
